newsitem.title: USA: Sun Coast plans to refinance existing debt.
newsitem.headline: Sun Coast plans to refinance existing debt.

text.p: Sun Coast Industries Inc said on Wednesday that it is not in compliance with two of its loan covenants at June 30, 1996, and plans to refinance its existing bank debt with another lender.
It plans to refinance prior to the filing of its annual report at the end of September, the company said.
In the absence of refinancing or a waiver, Sun Coast said its debt will be subject to acceleration and remain classified as current on its balance sheet at June 30, 1996.
